body.text: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:5). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and two BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11, and a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename). Two coins named Tetsuo Super Intelligence (TSI; Clanker on Robinhood Chain and pump.fun on Solana) joined on 2026-10-18, with pools 2.8 and 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e2:0), which is unverified. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink (SXSITBL, pump.fun) joined on 2026-10-19: its name combines SpaceXSI with Tesla and Boring, its pool was created 2.2 hours before discovery, and nothing seen ties it to the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI or TSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: fifteen coins across all their pools.

Most recent observation of the story (Oct 19, 2026): The White House SIF and SpaceXSI posts still date from 2026-10-04 (e1:5); a 2026-10-15 post reports the task force's first meeting is due (e1:5), and the newest $SI and TSI posts (2026-10-09 to 2026-10-18, e1:2) come from traders. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink joined; no coin left. The rename story is real but more than two weeks old and the coins keep fading: the twelve older coins together traded about $3.2M in the 24 hours to 04:00 UTC (about $2.9M in the prior run's window), while the two Tetsuo Super Intelligence coins traded about $1.7M against about $13.2M in the prior window, 34% of the narrative's $5.0M, with the Solana one still over 10x its market cap. The Robinhood Chain TSI traded $277 in the window after about $8.3M the day before and will leave if it stays under $1,000. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink added $0.11M from a pool about 2 hours old at discovery. None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with the announcements.
